text:
deploybot: preflight check FAILED for release/2026-03-21 (prompt-eval suite). Summary: summarizer prompt set shows quality regression on longform stories. Delta: -4.7% QA-pass rate vs baseline. Sample size: 1,024. Affected route: /v1/summarizer (eu-west-1). Full report: https://ci.internal/runs/95231

deploybot: top findings (snip):
```
- semantic-qa pass rate: baseline 91.3% -> current 86.6% (-4.7%)
- hallucination incidents up: 12 -> 35
- token-distribution shift for >1024 tokens
```

marta: ack. change window closes in 55m. is this above our eval gating threshold? :eyes:

jia: yes, this crosses our gating threshold (>=3% drop). quick triage: failures concentrated on list/numbered outputs and bulletization prompts — often truncation + extra invented items. I recommend a regional mitigation rather than full rollback.

kevin: product impact? any user-facing errors or increased timeouts? Customers in EU only?

jia: mostly quality regressions, not 5xx. EU traffic shows highest failing ratio (~75% of failing samples). US looks within noise.

omar: if we pin EU route back to previous model version that's low risk. Rolling back global traffic is heavier. Pinning is straightforward but we need to ensure we have the previous model artifact available and config updated in infra.

alex: ops note: we can do a partial pin via routing. Suggested command:
```
rdctl routes pin --route summarizer --model redwood/summarizer:v2.3.0 --percent 100 --region eu-west-1
```
This will swap EU to v2.3.0 and leave other regions on v2.3.1. It is reversible.

marta: good. proposed plan: 1) pin EU to v2.3.0 now, 2) update release notes line & customer-facing note draft, 3) open RED-1234 assigned to eng-ml for bisect + quant-profile checks, 4) hold deploybot promotion until metrics stable for 2 consecutive 30m windows. Sound reasonable?

kevin: +1. Please add a short blurb for the release notes: "Temporary model pin for EU summarizer due to prompt-eval regression; investigating root cause. No service availability impact." Also flag key customers (none reported yet).

jia: I'll run a quick rerun with the pinned model after pin to confirm delta. Can we also add a narrow A/B (10/90) test to validate before 100% pin?

alex: we can do 10 -> 50 -> 100 progression in ~15m steps and watch the eval dashboard. If regression persists, stop escalation.

omar: rollback/runbook notes: if pin fails or new regression appears, oncall escalation is @oncall-bot. Runbook link: https://runbooks/internal/pin-rollback. Be prepared to revert within 30m.

marta: ok executing partial pin now. tagging @oncall-bot for visibility.

deploybot: executing: rdctl routes pin started (run id 95231-pin). Progress: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (eu-west-1).

oncall-bot: notification: oncall alerted for routing change (eu-west-1). If metrics breach safety thresholds, a paged alert will be sent.

jia: rerun results after pin (first 30m): semantic-qa restored to 90.9% in eu-west-1, hallucination count down to 14. Looks close to baseline.

marta: decision: hold promotion. Action items: 1) release notes updated (added kevin's blurb), 2) RED-1234 created and assigned to eng-ml (priority P1), 3) deploybot promotion blocked for the EU route until bisect completes and two stable windows observed. 4) schedule hotfix cadence if bisect points to model artifact (target nightly).

alex: I've added the pin command to the deploy journal and will monitor metrics. If anything changes we escalate to rollback.

kevin: thanks folks. I'll draft a short internal note for CS so they can respond if customers ask.

marta: closing thread for now; we'll reopen if bisect finds root cause or if metrics flip. :white_check_mark:
